name: Zeeland Open 2013

information: Limit of 40 competitors. Competitors entrance fee will be 6€ for one day, 10€ for both. For 3x3 multi blindfold, the maximum will be 8, the WCA ranking for this event is leading to qualify if there are more than 8 registrations.
